reviews.comment: This online course is more interactive than the other face-to-face courses I am taking in person.  This prof genuinely shows effort.  I emailed him at midnight; by midnight thirty, this guy responded.  Insane.

I learned more from attending his class than any other class I had at Mays this summer.  Lectures were great, lots of writing but easy to do if you find your stride.  I highly recommend Mahler.  You'll learn some interesting business facts for sure.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: There was a lot of work, great class discussions, and strategy to me was learned better than my fellow Ags who took same class from different Professor in Spring.  A lot different and to me way more effective in Prof Mahler style.  Loved his class.
Amazing professor with an easy class 100% would recommend. Easy A and you have fun while doing it.
Great class to finish out my career.  Loved his class examples.
Only take 466 from Prof Mahler.  Best instructor I ever had.  I'm glad I graduate this weekend and so glad he was my last Prof here at A&M.
Best instructor for 466 strategy.  Straightforward and on point with examples.  Huge recommend Aggies!

A lot of work for Sunmer II class.  Best experience I never saw coming from a Strategy course.  Applied a lot of entrepreneurship in the class which made it really cool.  My Corp knows to take this guy.

A lot of work in 5 weeks but best professor I've ever had at A&M.  Professor Mahler made us think way outside the box.  Inspiring to hear his stories and it was great to work in teams during class.  The best.  Class is now over and I'm trying to think how I can implement strategy in everything.

All of us who took his class took away strategic value that is applicable to our next stages in professional life.  I could not have asked for a better summer class.  Lots of great examples to take with me. We all benefited.

I had more conversations with this professor, who was online-only, than I have had in 3 years with my in-person instructors.  I don't know what else to say other than this prof really shows he cares about our success beyond the class.  I cannot appreciate that enough.

There should be a class just on how this Professor communicates with everyone online.  This is by far the best class I have taken all year, and I have never heard of this guy until this summer. He is really genuine and laid-back, which, at A&M, has been a blessing in disguise compared to my other professors this summer.

I am taking his summer class now, and I feel like I would run through a wall for this professor.  This guy is unlike any other professor I have had here at A&M.  I cannot recommend enough that everyone should take 466 from him.
One of the best classes I had all Spring and Summer.  Great support, do the work, and you will do really well.

One of the best-organized online classes I have had while taking classes here at A&M. I learned a great deal and appreciated his prompt responses to my questions.  I would not take this class from any other professor.

This is one of my favorite classes that I have taken at Mays because it focuses on real-world skills as opposed to relying solely on the textbook and slides. Students learn better from application and discussion than they do from reliance on memorization. Professor Mahler is the most genuine prof I ever had here.  Also helped me land an internship.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great class.  Great experience.  Everything from the extra credit assignments to the Simulation games just made the entire class go well.  Professor Mahler was incredibly available and willing to help us at any time.  I would highly recommend him.

I have taken courses at many Universities, and no professor I experienced was like professor mahler.  He was outstanding.  Our class was asynch, and he made us feel like we were in a lecture hall, collaborating with one another and solving problems all over Texas.  This was an outstanding class taught by an outstanding instructor.

Creative Destruction Lab was a unique experience.  Seems like we did a lot of work for ventures in their program, some of us benefitted well, others not so much.  In terms of Professor Mahler leading it, he was great.  Seemed to always bring something to the lecture that we could apply to our venture work.

Outstanding experience as a student in his class.  Really brought a lot of thought to the classroom in terms of business mindset and thinking outside the box.  Great mentor to some of us, always accessible.  I really enjoyed his simulations, lectures, and his homework is not hard, just be ready to write.  I would highly recommend him.

One of the best Professors I have had here at A&M.  He responds to text a lot and kept me constantly in the loop of when things were coming up.  I loved his extra credit assignments and the simulations were easy.

Professor had the class structured well.  Quizzes are light reminders of the information covered that week.  A lot of opportunities for extra credit by getting involved, he was always responsive to my emails and texts. Enjoyed all the simulation games with it. I recommend taking this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Mahler taught me and many others to see business through a different lens.  Great class experience. Always well prepared.  The quizzes and class discussions were great.  I cannot recommend enough.

This professor should teach a class to the rest of the professors on how to engage with us Aggies when taking online classes.  WOW!  Professor Mahler was incredible as his class was well organized, unique, fun with GoVentures, and his examples were great.  I will tell all my sorority sisters to take 289 from mahler.
Professor is amazing.  Loves to help students succeed.  Best professor ever!
Great experience working with new ventures and loved the lectures and stories Prof Mahler shared in class.

Professor Mahler made this the best experience I have ever had in an asynchronous class.  He was very engaging with everyone, always available to answer questions, and certainly did his part to make sure everyone's input was considered when helping small business owners.  By the way, this is the coolest part about his class.

Best professor ever.  I said it.  He is more involved in our course than my face-to-face professors.  All of these Aggies are sharing the real deal on Prof Mahler.  I cannot recommend him enough; his class will be a great experience.

I never had a more involved Professor ever than my Professor for 289, Mahler.  That guy is either a workaholic, or just consumed his entire life in our success as students in his class.  I can't believe all his comments on here and can't disagree.  Absolutely amazing!  Best prof ever.

I could not recommend Professor Mahler more.  He was amazing with his time and seemed to care about my success as a student in the lecture hall, as well as in getting my first job, thanks to his help.  His LinkedIn workshop is the best on the entire campus, a must-attend for all Aggies.  I loved his lectures.
Outstanding class offering from Mays with an outstanding Professor.  Brought something new to every lecture and has helped me tremendously with my own startup ideas.  Highly recommend.
Best professor I had at Mays Business School.  Was very thorough and his style is just different than anything I had before.

Loved working on small business strategy that helped them grow.  Brought in great experiences to enhance the textbook material, overall one of the best I had here.  I would only take 466 from Professor Mahler.  Amazing beyond the classroom.

Best asynchronous course I ever had with reason being he made this course so incredible with communication, campus touring experiences, and best of all, his care for all of us with life beyond college.  This is a must take Professor.

He is so funny and gives a lot of extra credit, so it's hard to do poorly if you stay on track. Just meet deadlines and try. He helps with LinkedIn and career prep. GoVenture Kiosk was fun and teaches real business skills don't procrastinate, it takes time and can crash.

I took the online class, he cares about his students. Do the GoVentures ahead of time, if you do them the night of- you are screwing yourself over. They are easy but VERY time consuming. His quizzes are only 2 questions, so take all the extra credit because they are basically free points. I would 100% take him again.
Great experience. Loved working with all the ventures in energy.  Great class dialogue.

Huge upgrade from my other instructors here in Mays Business.  Lots of extra opportunities available in class, easily accessible, his lectures are entertaining with nuggets of food for thought attached.  I'll never forget Chile or Mitsubishi business model.  Great instructor for my last class here at A&M!
Never had a professor I could text at all hours and they would respond like Mahler.  He is 1,000% always available which makes class more enjoyable.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's a really good professor and the class was fine. The simulations are lengthy but easy. We have weekly discussion posts that I wasn't a fan of but they were easy just don't do it last minute cuz it starts getting laggy and will take forever to post. Overall super manageable class I highly recommend Mahler.

Professor cares more about us being secure in our ideas and starting a new business or succeeding in class than any other professor I have had since being here. This guy knows how to connect with students.  Amazing experience so far.  I cannot recommend enough.
Ags, for 466 senior graduating class, you want to take it from Mahler.  He brings something new every class.  His communication is quick.  Huge recommend.
Makes in class learning interesting and unique.  His business examples are something I will always take away from this class and provide to my own professional experiences.

To be fair, he was quick with answers to questions, provided lots of extra credit opportunities, and made me feel like a real student on campus even though this class was asynchronous.  One of the best instructors I have had here.

Best professor ever.  Don't know why there would be a hater, but at least he knows this is coming from College Station.  Don't these peeps know they mark where you leave a review?  They have you pinged.  Lol.  Seriousness aside, best instructor I had who was quick to respond, always available for office meetings, and led my team to launch.

If required to take Strategy of anything with Professor Mahler, he is the one you want to take it from.  Outstanding.  Who knew that Mitsubishi was everything but a car company.  He always brought joy to the class.

You throw Instructor Mahler under a bus; you have reasons to share or better back it up.  He is one of the most charismatic and forgiving Professors I have had at A&M.  He spoke at our future Business Leaders meeting, high impact.   Best instructor I have had in Mays.
Professor Mahler is one of the most involved instructors I have ever had.  His ability to respond immediately separates him from all the others. Our frat loves this guy.
Very difficult to get in contact with him, didn't really learn anything from the class. Loves to tell you how amazing he is at business.
This prof is amazing! Gives so much extra credit and offers students his personal phone number if they have questions. His assignments actually feel useful. Highly recommend!

Professor Mahler was the best instructor I had this semester.  For an asynch course, be prepared to learn a lot about our campus.  Be prepared to solve small business issues, learn a lot about management, GoVentures is awesome, and be open to visiting him in his office.  He inspired me to keep going with my venture.

One of the best and most inspiring Professors I've had in two years here at Mays.  He will not disappoint. Class is well organized, lots of opportunities to network in business, and he brings real small businesses to class.  Our online class worked with 11 and I gained more from that than any textbook could provide.

For an online course that felt like in-person, was all because the Prof Mahler went above and beyond any instructor I have had at Mays in making us feel like a community.  I am having him speak at the Corp he is that inspirational.  Class becomes easier with extra credit.  Simulation is fun.  Highly recommend this instructor.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I am so glad I was able to take a class from Professor Mahler.  What a great experience for being an online course. Everything was organized well, very responsive, and seemed to genuinely care about all of us doing well in his class.
One of the best professors I had while here at Mays.  I wish I would have had Professor Mahler face to face.

The content would have been boring but Professor Mahler made it really enjoyable.  Tons of opportunities to do well in class.  I enjoyed his LinkedIn workshop, a must see.  Well organized for having 700 of us in class.  I highly recommend him to any Aggie.
Best professor I had in Mays.  His content was organized, always responsive to me via text, email, or call, and really enjoyed the simulation he had us do.  Door was always open.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I cannot imagine the fuel this Prof brings to face to face classrooms.  I had more interaction with Professor Mahler in an asynchronous format than I did with all my other professors in their entirety who were face to face.  Professor Mahler opened the semester off with a call home assignment and ever since then, well, he was the best I ever had.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class
